The combination of features (frontal location, non-enhancing, limited edema) is highly characteristic of an IDH-mutant tumor. The prediction of 1p/19q co-deletion is made with low confidence due to non-specific features, but the cortically-based growth pattern without deep white matter invasion slightly favors this possibility. The final integrated diagnosis is consistent with the classic presentation of a grade 2 oligodendroglioma.
